metadata.title: CYBER-BRIDGE Requirement Catalogue - CRA Annex I, Part I (Product security requirements)

groups.title: Annex I, Part I - Cybersecurity requirements for products

controls.title: Appropriate level of cybersecurity based on the risks

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall be designed, developed and produced in such a way that they ensure an appropriate level of cybersecurity based on the risks.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The level of cybersecurity shall be determined on the basis of a cybersecurity risk assessment for the product with digital elements.

controls.title: Risk assessment documented and kept current

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The cybersecurity risk assessment shall be documented and updated as appropriate during the support period.

controls.title: No known exploitable vulnerabilities at market placement

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall be made available on the market without known exploitable vulnerabilities.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The manufacturer shall screen the product against known vulnerabilities before making it available on the market.

controls.title: Residual known vulnerabilities justified and mitigated

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Where a known vulnerability cannot be removed before market placement, the manufacturer shall record the justification and the mitigating measures applied.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall be made available on the market with a secure by default configuration.

controls.title: Deviation from secure default only by agreement

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A configuration other than the secure default shall apply only where otherwise agreed between manufacturer and business user for a tailor-made product.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The product shall provide the possibility to reset it to its original state.

controls.title: Secure default configuration documented for the user

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The secure default configuration shall be documented so that a user can establish whether the product is in that state.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall ensure that vulnerabilities can be addressed through security updates.

controls.title: Automatic security updates enabled by default

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Where applicable, security updates shall be installed automatically within an appropriate timeframe, enabled as a default setting.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Where automatic security updates apply, the product shall provide a clear and easy-to-use mechanism for the user to opt out.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The product shall notify users of available security updates.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The product shall give users the option to temporarily postpone a security update.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall ensure protection from unauthorised access by appropriate control mechanisms.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The control mechanisms shall include authentication of the entity seeking access.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The control mechanisms shall include identity or access management appropriate to the product and its intended use.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The product shall report on possible unauthorised access.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall protect the confidentiality of stored data, whether personal or other.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall protect the confidentiality of transmitted or otherwise processed data.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Where data is encrypted at rest or in transit, state-of-the-art mechanisms shall be used.

controls.title: Integrity of data protected against unauthorised manipulation

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall protect the integrity of stored, transmitted or otherwise processed data against manipulation or modification not authorised by the user.

controls.title: Integrity of commands, programs and configuration protected

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The protection shall extend to commands, programs and configuration of the product.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The product shall report on corruptions of data, commands, programs or configuration.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall process only data that are adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary in relation to the intended purpose of the product.

controls.title: Intended purpose defined as the basis for minimisation

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The intended purpose of the product shall be defined so that the adequacy, relevance and necessity of the data processed can be assessed against it.

controls.title: Availability of essential and basic functions protected

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall protect the availability of essential and basic functions.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The protection of essential and basic functions shall hold after an incident has occurred.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The product shall include resilience and mitigation measures against denial-of-service attacks.

controls.title: Negative impact on other devices or networks minimised

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall minimise their own negative impact on the availability of services provided by other devices or networks.

controls.title: Negative impact of connected devices minimised

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The minimisation shall extend to the negative impact of connected devices on the availability of services provided by other devices or networks.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall be designed, developed and produced to limit attack surfaces.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The limitation of attack surfaces shall include external interfaces.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall be designed, developed and produced to reduce the impact of an incident.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The reduction shall be achieved using appropriate exploitation mitigation mechanisms and techniques.

controls.title: Relevant internal activity recorded and monitored

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall provide security-related information by recording and monitoring relevant internal activity.

controls.title: Access to and modification of data, services or functions covered

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The recording shall include access to or modification of data, services or functions.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The recording and monitoring shall be accompanied by an opt-out mechanism for the user.

controls.title: Secure and permanent removal of data and settings

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Products with digital elements shall provide the possibility for users to securely and easily remove on a permanent basis all data and settings.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The removal shall be capable of being performed easily by the user.

controls.title: Secure transfer where data can be moved to other products

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Where the data can be transferred to other products or systems, the product shall ensure that this is done in a secure manner.
